description: Get one rule type across jurisdictions in one call, each entry in the same shape as get_rule. Example: `{"rule_type": "minimum_wage", "jurisdictions": ["us-wa", "us-or", "us-ca"]}`. Without `jurisdictions`, every state and province (or the `level` you name) is returned: about 3 KB each, 50+ entries. Entries are never merged or ranked. Each entry's `page_url` is that jurisdiction's juriset.dev page for people. Informational only, not legal advice. `as_of` needs an API key whose plan includes as-of queries.

domain.description: The rule type's domain, e.g. `employment`. Optional: when omitted it is looked up from the rule type.

jurisdictions.description: Up to 100 jurisdiction slugs, any level, e.g. `["us-wa", "us-or", "us-ca"]`. Not with `level`.

level.description: Instead of `jurisdictions`: every jurisdiction at these levels, e.g. `["state", "province"]` (the default).

rule_type.description: Rule type slug from list_rule_types, e.g. `minimum_wage`.

name: compare_jurisdictions
title: Compare jurisdictions
